correctness.rationale: For m,n>=3, every two-cell set lies inside a row-column cross and is not total dominating, while precisely the distinct-row/distinct-column triples are minimal; count 6 C(m,3) C(n,3). A product-edge slide changes both coordinates and must place the moved cell in a previously unoccupied row and column: each of three selected cells has (m-3)(n-3) choices. If min(m,n)=3 this freezes all states. At (4,4) completing the matching to four pairs partitions 96 states into 24 K4. For min>=4,max>=5 three explicit legal slide templates implement generating row/column exchanges, connecting all partial matchings; one-coordinate jumps with spare slots connect all n,m except (3,3). Independently generated state graphs for (3,3),(3,5),(4,4),(4,5),(5,5) and obtained predicted degrees/components; direct_check.py and matching_check.py source inspected. The infinite result rests on the written templates, not finite enumeration.
residual_risks: Finite state graph checks do not independently prove connectivity for unbounded m,n.
